description: Create-post feedback: the success toast and form reset run in onSettled, so a failed create also says 'Post created' and wipes what the user typed.
notes: FM-17 (user-facing truth). The reset, the success toast and the invalidation moved from onSuccess to onSettled, which also runs on error. A failed create (validation, unauthorized, network) shows "Failed to create post" and "Post created" together and wipes the title and content the user typed, so the user acts on a falsehood and loses their work. Severity important: FM-17 is important when the user acts on a falsehood or loses work. Fix: keep form.reset() and toast.success() in onSuccess (invalidation may stay in onSettled).
